noncomputable def VTask.prev {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  -- Convert list to (index, element) pairs for easier indexing
  let l' := List.zipWith (· + 1) l
  -- Find the index of x in l', using the membership hypothesis
  let x_idx := l'.find? h |>.getD 0
  -- The cyclic predecessor is the element at position (x_idx - 1) mod list_length
  let list_length := l'.length
  let prev_idx := (x_idx + list_length - 1) % list_length
  -- Get the element at the previous index
  (l'.get? prev_idx).getD l.getLast!
